text:
micah: Quick heads-up — Polaris Health asked to run a POC with a customer-provided Mistral-derived variant. They want: dedicated capacity (2xA100), KV cache support, and on-prem/KMS for PHI. Can we confirm model catalog compatibility and any known blockers? @jordan can you run a variant scan?
jordan: Yep, will kick off the compat scan now. Need the model artifact name and a snippet of the config they plan to use.
micah: Model artifact they supplied: `polaris/mistral-custom-7b:v3`. Config they pasted: ```
model: polaris/mistral-custom-7b
max_seq_len: 4096
quant: int8
kv_cache: true
```
jordan: Got it. Starting automated checks (ops-compat + quantization profile + KV integration). This might flag RMSNorm differences or custom tokenizers.
eng-bot: Variant scan started for `polaris/mistral-custom-7b:v3` — estimated time ~4m. Checks: topology, tokenizer, kv-ops, attention patterns, fused-kernels compatibility.
sam: From pricing side — if they want dedicated 2xA100 reserved monthly with peak bursting, rough committed cost would be ~$28k/mo plus model memory premium for int8 quant variants. If they do private (VPC) + KMS + 90-day retention for observability logs add ~$6k/mo. I can produce a formal estimate.
micah: Thanks. Also they sent a security questionnaire asking about key management and PHI handling. Monica, any immediate red flags?
monica: For PHI + on-prem requirement we need: strong KMS integration (customer-managed keys), SOC2/ISO attestation, and an import/export policy for logs. Also confirm that audit logs can be kept off-platform if required. I'll start the sec q review.
jordan: Quick note from scan: tokenizer uses an extra <|extra_sep|> token and the positional embeddings are aligned for 8k but they're sending 4k config — should be fine but ops needs to ensure kv shard placement won't blow memory with 4096. Also quant profile includes per-channel scales which our default int8 path supports but we need to validate with a test compile.
eng-bot: Variant scan result: topology OK, tokenizer mismatch flagged (custom token id 50256+), KV memory estimate: 36GB for 2xA100 with 4k context (with caching enabled). Suggest compile test on a dev node.
tara: Ops can run a compile + smoke run on a dev GPU this afternoon. We need a sample prompt set (10 short prompts) and the model wheel. Who has the artifact?
micah: Polaris uploaded to our intake bucket: s3://redwood-inbound/polaris/mistral-custom-7b-v3.tar.gz. I'll share an IAM link in a separate DM.
sam: For the formal quote, two options: 1) Reserved 2xA100 + private control plane: $34k/mo (includes KMS + 30-day logs). 2) Hosted dedicated burst add-on (no private control plane): $22k/mo but no customer-managed KMS. Which does sales prefer to pitch?
micah: Pitch #1 — they insisted on customer KMS. We'll need the legal copy for the KMS SLA.
monica: Legal/Compliance note: For PHI, addendum required for data processing + breach notification window <=72h. Also need to confirm regional data residency (their corp is EU/US hybrid). I'll flag points in the questionnaire.
jordan: Next technical step: ops to run compile + perf profile, then I’ll run an eval suite to check output drift vs baseline (we should run 200 prompts including PII redaction cases). Can we book a 30m sync with Polaris this week?
tara: I have a 2pm slot Thu that works for ops.
sam: I'll prepare preliminary SOW + quote to share ahead of the sync.
micah: Great — action items: jordan run eval + drift checks, tara run compile & perf, monica finish sec q flags, sam draft SOW/quote. I'll coordinate sync invite.
jordan: On it. Will post a short report in this thread after the compile run.
eng-bot: Compile job queued on dev-gpu-7. Job id: cj-2024945012345.
micah: Thanks team :thumbsup:
